claim: LangSmith is the default for LangChain/LangGraph teams, Langfuse leads open-source self-hosted observability, and Braintrust is the eval-first SaaS choice; LLM-first tools observe individual requests vs agent-first session analysis.
quote: LangSmith remains the right default for LangChain teams... Langfuse remains the best choice for self-hosted, open-source, minimal-overhead observability... Braintrust is the best evaluation-first platform with the most generous free tier.

claim: Langfuse Cloud has a free Hobby tier (50,000 units/month, 30-day retention, 2 seats), Core at $29/mo, Pro at $199/mo, Enterprise at $2,499/mo, with no per-seat charge and overage at $8 per 100,000 units.
quote: Hobby (Free): 50,000 units per month with 30-day data retention and two user seats; Core: $29/month; Pro: $199/month; Enterprise: $2,499/month. All paid tiers include unlimited users.

claim: Langfuse's core is MIT-licensed and fully self-hostable for free with no event limits; in June 2025 it open-sourced all remaining cloud-only features including managed LLM-as-a-judge evals, annotation queues, and prompt experiments.
quote: Self-host all core Langfuse features for free without any limitations. Langfuse's core product is MIT-licensed... In June 2025, Langfuse open-sourced all remaining cloud-only product features under MIT.

claim: On January 16, 2026 ClickHouse raised a $400M Series D and acquired Langfuse (founded 2023, 2,000+ paying customers, 26M+ monthly SDK installs, used by 63 of the Fortune 500); ClickHouse committed to keeping Langfuse MIT-licensed and self-hostable.
quote: ClickHouse raises $400M Series D led by Dragoneer to accelerate expansion across analytics and AI infrastructure... acquisition of Langfuse, the open-source LLM observability platform... committed to keeping Langfuse MIT licensed.

claim: LangSmith pricing: Developer (free, 5,000 traces/mo, 14-day retention, single seat), Plus at $39/seat/mo (10,000 traces included, $0.50 per 1,000 overage traces), and unpublished Enterprise; LangSmith ships from the LangChain maintainers.
quote: Developer (Free): 5,000 traces per month with 14-day retention, limited to a single seat... LangSmith Plus costs (seats x $39) + ((traces - 10,000) / 1,000 x $0.50)

claim: Braintrust eliminates per-seat pricing: Starter (free, unlimited users, 1M trace spans, 10k scores), Pro at $249/mo (unlimited users and spans, 50k scores), and custom Enterprise; a 100-person team still starts at $249/mo.
quote: Braintrust eliminates per-seat pricing entirely. Every tier includes unlimited users... Starter (Free): unlimited users, 1M trace spans, and 10k scores; Pro: $249 per month... 50k scores.

claim: Arize Phoenix is an OpenTelemetry/OpenInference-native, source-available (Elastic License 2.0) AI observability and evaluation platform, free to self-host, with ~10,000 GitHub stars.
quote: Arize Phoenix is OpenTelemetry-native and open-source... Phoenix is source-available under Elastic License 2.0... Phoenix's OpenTelemetry foundation prevents vendor lock-in.

claim: W&B Weave is closed-source with a strong eval harness, single @weave.op() decorator MCP auto-logging, and real-time guardrails, fitting teams already on the Weights & Biases console; Phoenix returns eval explanations by default with batching speedups.
quote: Weave has a strong eval harness, and MCP auto-logging requires a single @weave.op() decorator, and guardrails provide real-time agent behavior controls... If your ML team is already on W&B, Weave fits in the same console.

claim: In August 2025 Anthropic acqui-hired Humanloop's three co-founders (Raza Habib, Peter Hayes, Jordan Burgess) plus ~a dozen engineers without acquiring the IP; Humanloop notified customers it was shutting down, going offline September 8, 2025.
quote: Three co-founders moved to Anthropic: CEO Raza Habib, CTO Peter Hayes, and CPO Jordan Burgess... 'around a dozen engineers and researchers'... did not acquire Humanloop or its IP... 'shutting down in preparation for an acquisition.'

claim: Comet Opik is a true open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform whose core feature set is free in the source code (self-hostable), with an enterprise-ready scalable hosted version; the project has ~19,500 GitHub stars.
quote: Opik is a true open-source project, and its core AI observability and evaluation feature set is included free in the source code. You can download the code from GitHub and run it locally.

claim: Braintrust raised a $36M Series A led by a16z (Martin Casado) with angels including Greg Brockman, Guillermo Rauch and Arthur Mensch, followed by an $80M Series B led by ICONIQ Capital in February 2026.
quote: Braintrust's Series A funding round of $36 million was led by Martin Casado at Andreessen Horowitz... Braintrust raised $80 million in a Series B round led by ICONIQ Capital.

claim: Weights & Biases (parent of the Weave LLM eval/observability product) was acquired by GPU cloud provider CoreWeave for ~$1.7B, completed May 5, 2025; W&B Weave is the LLMOps solution for tracking and evaluating LLM applications.
quote: CoreWeave, Inc. (Nasdaq: CRWV) completed its acquisition of Weights & Biases on May 5, 2025... W&B Weave is the LLMOps solution for software developers to track and evaluate LLM applications.
